state.description: State is none (no update has run), installing, done or failed.

tag.description: Tag is the release being installed, once known.

step.description: Step is what it's doing (or last did), in words.

detail.description: Detail is the latest line of the step's output (a build's), if any.

log.description: Log is the file a detached update writes its whole output to.

title: procauto update progress --json
description: UpdateProgress is `update progress --json`: the latest update, as it goes.
